threads.subject: read this when you're not at work

messages.body:
Pulled the Ledger's 1971 coverage from our microfilm and the 2021 piece. Links below (the Ledger digitized it, bless them). Read the mother's quotes. Then read the 2021 one. Then call me.

https://harbourledger.ca/archive/1971-mahar
https://harbourledger.ca/archive/1971-mahar-2
https://harbourledger.ca/archive/2021-mahar

Also there's a Bernadette Mahar in the 1972 city directory at 1341 Barrington, which is now a parking lot, because of course it is.

P

"she had eleven dollars and a baby"

calling you

Found the last box of your stuff in the hall closet. Two hydrophones, the green sweater, the Zoom H1 you said was broken (it isn't), and the book about lighthouses I gave you that you never read. I'll leave it with Priya.

I hope the new place is quiet. I know that matters to you.

J

thank you. keep the sweater, it was always yours really.

it's quiet. there's a fridge that does a thing at 3am. I've recorded it.

w

w

hi.

if this is in the inbox, the thing I built worked, and you're one of the strangers who ended up with a copy of my laptop. sorry. and thank you.

it's all real. I didn't tidy it. if I was going to ask people I've never met to hold something for me, they should get to see who's asking.

what I'm asking is small: read the folder called Slow Rooms. keep a copy of what's in it somewhere that isn't Nova Scotia. and remember a name: Colleen Anne Mahar.

if you want to talk, my old whatsapp still works from where I am. I'll know when you've been through things; the relay tells me. don't be weird about it.

w
